Employment Situation News Release
THE EMPLOYMENT SITUATION - AUGUST 2026
Total nonfarm payroll employment changed little in August (+5,000), and the unemployment rate edged up to 4.3 percent. Average hourly earnings for all employees on private nonfarm payrolls rose by 0.1 percent over the month and by 3.1 percent over the year. The labor force participation rate was unchanged at 61.4 percent, and the average workweek remained at 34.3 hours.
